title: Insight permission and override gating: canEditInsight, hasOverrides, editingDisabledReason
answers: What is editingDisabledReason and who uses it?
body:
- insightLogic.tsx selectors: `canEditInsight` (~L1009): true if `insight.user_access_level` missing else `accessLevelSatisfied(Insight, level, Editor)`; ignores mode/dashboard/overrides. `hasOverrides` (~L1052) from filtersOverride/variablesOverride/tileFiltersOverride; `editingDisabledReason` (~L1066) = 'Discard overrides to edit the insight.' or null. `isInDashboardContext` (~L967) = `!!props.dashboardId`. insightSceneLogic has its own separate `hasOverrides`.
- canEditInsight must be honored by: InsightPageHeader (Edit button, name/description canEdit; Edit also wrapped in AccessControlAction minAccessLevel=Editor), InsightSceneMenuBar, SidePanel/InsightPanelInfo, InsightModals, InsightDisplayConfig (compare `disabled`), InsightVizDisplay (`canCheckUncheckSeries`), insightSceneLogic breadcrumb `forceEditMode`, and retention filters in products/product_analytics/frontend/insights/retention/filters/ (return null when !canEditInsight).
- editingDisabledReason is only applied where passed as `disabledReason`: InsightDisplayConfig, InsightDateFilter, ColorCustomizationColumn, retention BreakdownFilter/DatePicker/ChartPicker, PathStepPicker. Retention pickers guarding on canEditInsight don't use it. New edit controls must add both checks.
applies: Insight controls in scenes/insights and product_analytics; dashboard tiles use dashboardId props rather than scene state.
